bug_description.original: Crash Type: Bad-free Crash Address: 0x7ffc164d8fa8 Crash State: sc_pkcs15_decode_prkdf_entry fuzz_pkcs15_decode.c Sanitizer: address (ASAN)
bug_description.normalized: In sc_pkcs15_decode_prkdf_entry, the error-cleanup path calls free(asn1_com_prkey_attr[0].parm), but parm holds &info.subject.value — the address of a stack-local field — rather than info.subject.value itself (the heap pointer). This passes a stack address to free(), triggering a bad-free when sc_asn1_decode_choice fails on malformed ASN.1 input.

source.description: ASN.1 decode of attacker-controlled private key data file entry
source.note: Attacker-controlled ASN.1 data from the fuzzer buffer is parsed. sc_asn1_decode_choice partially decodes the input and may internally allocate memory (via SC_ASN1_ALLOC) for info.subject.value before encountering an error and returning r < 0.

relation.description: Source identity relation for the vulnerability-relevant value.

root_cause.description: Error cleanup frees the parm pointer (stack address of info.subject.value) instead of the heap-allocated value it points to
root_cause.note: sc_format_asn1_entry stores &info.subject.value (the address of the stack-local pointer field) into asn1_com_prkey_attr[0].parm. The error handler later uses parm as the argument to free, but parm is a pointer-to-pointer (stack address), not the heap pointer itself.

sink.description: free() called on stack address &info.subject.value instead of heap pointer info.subject.value
sink.note: free() is called with asn1_com_prkey_attr[0].parm, which equals &info.subject.value — a stack address at offset 360 within the info local variable. ASAN detects this as a bad-free because the address was never malloc'd.

parser_admitted.note: sc_asn1_decode_choice begins parsing the attacker-controlled ASN.1 buffer as a PrKDF entry.

tainted_value_origin.note: Fuzzer-provided Data/Size buffer is passed as *buf/*buflen to sc_pkcs15_decode_prkdf_entry via the decode_entries function pointer array.

fine_trace.note: Sets asn1_com_prkey_attr[0].parm = &info.subject.value. parm now holds the stack address of the pointer field info.subject.value (type u8**), not a heap allocation. The c_asn1_com_prkey_attr template specifies SC_ASN1_ALLOC|SC_ASN1_OCTET_STRING for subjectName, so the decoder will later malloc into *(u8**)parm.

Parses the attacker-controlled ASN.1 buffer. Partial decoding may set SC_ASN1_PRESENT on asn1_com_prkey_attr[0] and allocate memory into info.subject.value via the SC_ASN1_ALLOC path. Returns r < 0 on the malformed input.
Decode returned error (r < 0), entering the error-cleanup branch.
Checks whether the subjectName ASN.1 entry was partially decoded (SC_ASN1_PRESENT set). For the triggering input, partial decoding set this flag, so the cleanup branch is reached.

Calls free() on asn1_com_prkey_attr[0].parm, which is &info.subject.value — a stack address (offset 360 in the info local at stack frame offset 32). Should have called free(info.subject.value) to free the heap-allocated buffer. ASAN reports bad-free at this address.

poc.trigger: The PoC is a malformed ASN.1 blob that when passed to sc_pkcs15_decode_prkdf_entry causes sc_asn1_decode_choice to partially decode (setting SC_ASN1_PRESENT on the subjectName entry) then fail, triggering the error cleanup path that calls free on a stack address.

format.name: ASN.1/DER
format.contract: Malformed ASN.1 private key data file (PrKDF) entry that causes partial decoding of the subjectName field followed by a decode error, triggering the bad-free cleanup path.
